full_judgment: 5. Although two LCs were opened for 143 fax machines, only 120 machines were shipped and arrived at Chittagong Port. To avoid demurrage and pilferage in the port the petitioner requested respondent Nos. 1 and 2 to release the goods on urgent basis upon payment of all dues of customs and other authorities. But respondent No. 1 by letter dated 19-9-1988 requested the petitioner to release the said 120 fax machines on payment of customs duty, sales tax and other charges against facility like Murabaha. Respondent No. 1 also undertook to release the said goods within 90 days from the petitioner's custody. The petitioner accordingly released the goods by paying all dues and also 90% of the. LC money to the supplier.
